study_title: When Does Growth Pay Off? Investment Timing in Small Caps
pilot_scope: Complete usable listed IWM equity coverage, with explicit mapping and reporting gaps
target_scope: Dated Russell 2000 membership and security-level total return panel, including exits and delistings
analysis_status: no fitted models, no historical membership panel, no claims of alpha

hypotheses.name: Entry before earnings
hypotheses.null: Waiting for sustained profits has no out-of-sample benefit after missed upside and costs

hypotheses.name: Price versus expectations
hypotheses.null: Forecast revisions add no predictive information after price and valuation

hypotheses.name: Macro interaction
hypotheses.null: Rates, inflation, employment and credit conditions do not change the timing relationship

hypotheses.name: Quality of profit
hypotheses.null: Cash conversion and margin breadth add no information over EPS growth

hypotheses.name: Ability to wait
hypotheses.null: Funding runway and debt maturities have no incremental association with timing outcomes

hypotheses.name: Dilution
hypotheses.null: New share issuance does not change per-original-share recovery outcomes

hypotheses.name: EPS outlook
hypotheses.null: Vintage EPS forecast revisions and disagreement have no out-of-sample information

hypotheses.name: Composition
hypotheses.null: Fixed-member and changing-member improvements do not differ

hypotheses.name: Economic timing value
hypotheses.null: A timing rule does not improve net returns over the predeclared comparators

registration_status: Draft protocol in version control; no external preregistration and no fitted analysis
implemented_infrastructure: Hashed raw inputs and offline replication
Conservative capital metrics and partial tagged maturities
plain_language_objective: Find a better time to invest in small caps by testing the economy, profits, expectations and the price paid together

research_focus.scope_status: All usable listed IWM holdings as a current proxy; not certified Russell membership

timing_status: Deterministic scenarios implemented; no fitted timing model, no validated buy signal

timing_design.training: Chronological expanding windows with purged overlapping labels and a final untouched test period
timing_design.primary_timing_endpoint: Net-of-cost 12-month excess total return over IWM at matched risk
required_inputs_not_connected: Original-vintage analyst EPS forecasts and revisions
